title: Make a Validated Contact Form
prompt:
Validate required fields and email format, show errors accessibly, and process valid submissions without trusting client-side validation alone.

Submission: a small reviewable artifact, relevant tests, expected outputs, one failure/boundary case, and version/environment notes. Use synthetic data. Django/Python server code is not executed by CodeLeaf browser preview; local or human review is required.
target_skills: Build a Django Form with required fields and sensible length bounds.
Handle GET and POST correctly and render field errors/labels.
Test valid and invalid server-side submissions.

starter.content:
from django import forms

class ContactForm(forms.Form):
    name = forms.CharField(max_length=80)
    email = forms.EmailField()
    message = forms.CharField(widget=forms.Textarea)
starter.code:
from django import forms

class ContactForm(forms.Form):
    name = forms.CharField(max_length=80)
    email = forms.EmailField()
    message = forms.CharField(widget=forms.Textarea)

expected_output: Test empty name and malformed email as well as one valid submission.
acceptance_criteria: A valid submission follows a deliberate success path.
The page displays associated labels and validation errors.
State whether verification was local, static, or human-reviewed.
Do not claim a build/deployment or external integration was tested unless it was actually run.
hints: Retain CSRF protection and an accessible error summary.
grading_method: Required-string smoke check plus human review of technical correctness, tests, safe handling, expected result and reproducibility. This does not execute arbitrary Python/Django code.
retry_policy: Retries are allowed after reviewing feedback; the platform backend owns its uniform XP/idempotency rules.
